answer: Fix each epoch's reward as one sealed pool split strictly in proportion to peer-verified work: a single jade vein no miner can enlarge. Spin up a grove of 1,000 clones and the pool never grows; it only subdivides, each fake drawing ~1/1000 of one honest share while still paying full signup, stake and compute per head. The pool is one walnut: cracking it into more pieces yields no more meat. Net emission and vote-weight stay flat at any count, so cloning is self-defeating: strictly linear dilution, zero marginal gain, no way to pool the thinned shares back without collapsing to one identity.
